name: qa-iac
description: Infrastructure-as-code testing + security policy: 4 skills (helm-chart-tester, policy-as-code-runner, checkov-policy, trivy-config - the tfsec successor, with the legacy tfsec workflow in its references) and 1 agent (terraform-plan-reviewer). Cross-scanner IaC finding triage is handled by security-finding-triager in the qa-security-scanning plugin.
